Which actor voices the lovable panda Po in the animated film Kung Fu Panda?
questions.explanation: Jack Black voices Po, the clumsy but determined panda who dreams of becoming a kung fu master in the 2008 DreamWorks animated film Kung Fu Panda. The film was a massive hit and spawned multiple sequels and spin-offs. Black's energetic and comedic personality was considered a perfect fit for the lovable protagonist.

questions.question: Which animated series concluded its original run after ten seasons in 2018?
questions.explanation: Adventure Time aired on Cartoon Network and wrapped up its original run in 2018 after ten seasons. The show was beloved for its imaginative storytelling and has since spawned several spin-offs and specials, keeping the Land of Ooo alive for fans.

questions.question: According to creator Chris Savino, which Nickelodeon cartoon character was designed as the middle child with five older sisters and five younger sisters?
questions.explanation: Lincoln Loud is the central character of Nickelodeon's "The Loud House," intentionally placed as the sole brother sandwiched between ten sisters. Creator Chris Savino designed this unique family dynamic to create endless comedic and relatable situations around sibling life. The show premiered in 2016 and became one of Nickelodeon's most popular animated series.

questions.question: Which animation studio held the exclusive rights to use the rotoscoping technique until 1934, before Disney later adapted it for Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs?
questions.explanation: Fleischer Studios, founded by brothers Max and Dave Fleischer, pioneered rotoscoping — a technique of tracing over live-action footage frame by frame to create realistic movement. They held exclusive rights to the process until 1934, after which Disney famously employed it to bring lifelike motion to characters in Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937).
